# 大乘法界無差別論

**ID:** T1627
**Volume:** T31
**Category:** 瑜伽部類
**Original Category:** 瑜伽部
**Byline:** 堅慧菩薩造  唐 提雲般若譯
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 692

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A second, slightly differing single-fascicle Chinese version of the *Mahāyānadharmadhātu-aviśeṣa-śāstra* attributed to [堅慧菩薩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A0%85%E6%85%A7%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9) (Sāramati). Both this version and [KR6n0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0089) (T31n1626) are attributed to the same translator, [提雲般若](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%8F%90%E9%9B%B2%E8%88%AC%E8%8B%A5) (Devaprajñā), suggesting either a revision in the same translation circle or a parallel transmission of two distinct recensions of the Indian text. Preserved in the Taishō (T31n1627), with limited edition support (only 【大】and 【大→明】 in the catalog).

**Abstract**

The relationship between this text and [KR6n0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0089) is a long-standing scholarly puzzle. The two translations are by the same translator (or his circle), of (apparently) the same Indian text, but differ in textual particulars. Possibilities include: (a) two distinct Chinese renderings of the same Indian text, perhaps separated by some short period; (b) two Chinese renderings of two distinct Indian recensions; (c) one a revision of the other. The catalog dating window adopted (690–691) follows the bracket for the parent text [KR6n0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0089), on the assumption that both translations belong to the same cluster of Devaprajñā activity.

The text is doctrinally identical in substance to [KR6n0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0089) and is treated together with that text in the Hua-yan-school commentarial tradition. [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F)'s commentary [KR6n0091](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0091) is on the better-attested recension T31n1626. The minor variant T31n1627 is rarely cited independently.
